items.title: Olmstead’s Seven Imposing in $59,400 Northlands Futurity Thursday at Canterbury Park
items.summary: Quarter Horse trainer Jason Olmstead will saddle seven 2-year-olds, including the five fastest qualifiers, in the $59,400 Northlands Futurity Thursday at Canterbury Park. items.title: That Type Ofa Deal provides upset in Minnesota Derby at Canterbury Park
items.summary: That Type Ofa Deal raced in the back of the four-horse Minnesota Derby field only looking like a winner inside the sixteenth pole of the 1 mile 70 yard race when, under leading jockey Manuel Americano, the 3-year-old Minnesota-bred surged past pace-setter Navarre and rail-hugging Perfect Gamble to a one-length win in the $75,000 stake […]

items.title: Trainer Tony Rengstorf seeks first Minnesota Derby win Saturday at Canterbury Park
items.summary: Tony Rengstorf has trained racehorses at Canterbury Park since 1990, winning multiple stakes races along the way. One race that has eluded the Minnesota native is the Minnesota Derby, the premiere 3-year-old race for state-breds conducted annually at the Shakopee racetrack. Saturday evening he will saddle 4 to 5 morning line favorite How Bout That […]

items.title: Northlands Futurity and Quarter Horse Derby trials Thursday at Canterbury Park; Trainer Jason Olmstead expected to be a force; Hobbs brings Ding Dang Dulce to derby heats
items.summary: Two pairs of trials will be run Thursday at Canterbury Park qualifying quarter horses for finals on Aug. 20. Races 1 and 2 at 400 yards will send the 10 fastest 3-year-olds to the $36,675 Canterbury Park Quarter Horse Derby while 2-year-olds compete at 350 yards in races 3 and 4 to determine 10 finalists […]

items.title: Sheza a Sugar Momma wins MQHRA Stallion Auction Futurity; Relentless Legacy repeats in Bob Morehouse Stakes
items.summary: Sheza a Sugar Momma won by a head in the $49,354 MQHRA Stallion Auction Futurity Thursday at Canterbury Park. The 2-year-old Minnesota bred quarter horse filly has now won two of three starts and $43,970 in purses. Sheza a Sugar Momma is owned by Tom Maher and Paul Luedemann and was bred by Summer Run. […]

items.summary: Canterbury Park’s eight-race program on Thursday begins with a pair of quarter horse stakes, the $29,500 Bob Morehouse and the $49,354 MQHRA Stallion Auction Futurity.
